technical_features.labels_or_markings: No visible labels or markings; surface shows minor wear and darkened grout lines.

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Tiles can be removed intact using a tile removal tool or chisel with care to avoid cracking. Grout joints should be scored first. Use dust suppression. Check for underlying subfloor condition before removal.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Verify grout composition for potential asbestos or Portland cement-based mastic; test if necessary before removal.
Inspect tile edges for hidden lead-based paint or sealant residues, especially if building predates 1978.
